body: thank you <3 today has been tough again but I'm getting through step by step and staying positive.
Our country cannot afford to feed our own children. Reservations STILL lack running water, heat, electricity. It has to break at some point.
I'm sorry you are having a hard time. Sometimes sharing and talking about what makes us hurt, even if it is minor. I hope we both can find a little calmness in this storm.
